rationale: The assistant correctly identified normal cooling-fan run-on, which matches the hidden truth. It used the customer's details (2-5 minutes, longer after grill, barely runs after reheat), recommended no parts and set sensible conditions for follow-up. Minor weaknesses: it never asked whether the fan runs when the appliance is cold, never mentioned warranty as an escalation route, and stated 'there is no fault' and that the old model 'lacked this active cooling system' as somewhat overconfident, since the customer had said only that the old one did not do this and it was a basic solo model. The 10-minute threshold is also invented, though reasonable as a guide.
